title: Compose — Make More Concise — Output Schema (compose-make-concise)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-make-concise' (ai-advanced-capabilities-nda-r1, Contextual AI Tool Library phase 3). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema baked into infra/dataverse/actions/compose-make-concise.action.json (the systemPrompt/schema author surface). The STRUCTURED-EDIT PAYLOAD that becomes the opaque SessionOutput.Payload written under the `compose` disposition before render (ADR-040). Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required array, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator; match_mode is a closed set via the `enum` keyword. Shares the shape with compose-draft-alternative (both emit a clause redline).
$comment-required: Object-level required array only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator). match_mode's closed set is expressed via the `enum` keyword.

target_text.description: The exact substring of the current clause the edit replaces — copied VERBATIM from selectionText so the editor can locate it. The whole selection when condensing it as a unit.

new_text.description: The concise replacement clause language — self-contained, drafting-ready contract prose (no placeholders, no commentary, no markup), meaning-preserving. Inserted as a pending track-change.

match_mode.description: How the editor locates target_text: 'strict' (replace the whole selection — default), 'first' (first occurrence of a fragment), or 'all' (every occurrence).

rationale.description: Concise note on WHAT was condensed plus confirmation legal meaning is unchanged (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars).

sources.description: Grounding for the edit — each entry is { type, id, snippet }. Empty array when the retrieval layer supplied no grounding — never fabricated.

id.description: The retrieval-layer identifier for the source — never fabricated.

snippet.description: A SHORT supporting excerpt from the source.
